strongest_angle: Analyzing the October 2026 CBS News reports detailing why rushing to pay off debt too aggressively can drain essential liquidity, strain cash flow, and leave households unprepared for financial emergencies.

key_facts.fact: CBS News reported on October 7, 2026, that paying off debt too aggressively can strain household liquidity and leave borrowers unprepared for emergencies.
InCharge Debt Solutions noted on June 10, 2026, that paying off debt too quickly can strain cash flow and sometimes trigger credit score changes.
Joe Lum, a certified financial planner at Intersect Capital, told CNBC Select that aggressive debt reduction can feel like walking a tightrope with cash flow.
Business Insider and Money.com referenced a 2026 Freedom Debt Relief survey involving borrowers carrying at least 10,000 dollars in non-student debt.

numbers.label: Minimum non-student debt threshold in survey
